faq_heading: Chilliwack Downtown condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Downtown sell for?
faq.a: 27 condos sold in Chilliwack Downtown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $288,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Chilliwack Downtown?
faq.a: The median was 33 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Downtown sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 27 condos that sold in Chilliwack Downtown went for between $226,250 and $375,750, around a median of $288,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Downtown sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 27 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.9% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Downtown?
faq.a: Of the 27 sales, 27 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $415.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Downtown?
faq.a: The median year built was 1993 for the 27 condos sold in Chilliwack Downtown.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Downtown usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Chilliwack Downtown had 2 bedrooms, from the 27 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Downtown condos and townhomes for sale now
What Chilliwack Downtown condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

27 condos sold in Chilliwack Downtown with a median price of $288,000 (the middle half sold between $226,250 and $375,750), taking a median of 33 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $322 per square foot, a median year built of 1993 and a median strata fee of $415 a month.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Downtown compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median condo in Chilliwack Downtown sold for $288,000, 7% below the Chilliwack median of $310,000 across 133 sales. Chilliwack Downtown condos took a median 33 days to sell, against 36 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
